parameters.name: BatchType
parameters.description:
The type of the batch operation. Valid values:

- **DOMAIN\_ADD**: Add domain names in batches.

- **DOMAIN\_DEL**: Delete domain names in batches.

- **RR\_ADD**: Add DNS records in batches.

- **RR\_DEL**: Delete DNS records in batches.

> If you leave this parameter empty, the results are not filtered by operation type.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. The default value is **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the task. If you do not specify this parameter, the details of tasks in all states are returned.
